name: @optn/docker-dev
description: OPTN Wallet production-grade contributor/lab Docker image (not consumer wallet)

scripts.shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml exec --user 1000:1000 dev bash
scripts.test:core: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps --user 1000:1000 --workdir /optn dev bash -lc "npm ci && npm run test:core"
scripts.logs:tor: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml --profile fusion-lab logs -f tor
